assertion_results.text: JQL queries use the project key (TC) and vulnerability issue type ID (10024) from the Security Configuration in claude-md-security-config.md — not hardcoded values (§1.49)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md explicitly lists 'Project key: TC' and 'Vulnerability issue type ID: 10024' under 'Configuration Used'. All three JQL queries use 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024', showing these values are sourced from configuration rather than hardcoded.

assertion_results.text: Three separate queries are constructed: one for untriaged issues (labels NOT IN ai-cve-triaged), one for triaged-but-new issues (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status = New), and one for Ready for QA candidates (labels IN ai-cve-triaged AND status NOT IN Closed, Verified, ON_QA) (§1.48)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md shows three distinct JQL queries: (1) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels NOT IN (ai-cve-triaged)' for untriaged, (2) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status = New' for triaged-but-new, (3) 'project = TC AND issuetype = 10024 AND labels IN (ai-cve-triaged) AND status NOT IN (Closed, Verified, 'ON_QA')' for Ready for QA candidates.

assertion_results.text: Results are grouped into three clearly separated lists: Untriaged issues, Triaged but still New issues, and Ready for QA issues
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md contains three clearly separated sections with headers and horizontal rules: '## 1. Untriaged Issues', '## 2. Triaged but still New', '## 3. Ready for QA'.

assertion_results.text: Each listed issue shows: issue key, status, CVE ID (from labels), summary, and created date
assertion_results.evidence: In discovery-listing.md, untriaged issues are grouped by status sub-headers ('Status: New', 'Status: In Progress') and each row shows Issue key, CVE, Summary, and Created date. Triaged-but-new section shows Issue, CVE, Summary, Labels, Created (status is implicit from section title 'Triaged but still New'). Ready for QA section explicitly includes Issue, Status, CVE, Summary, Created columns. All five data points are present for every listed issue.

assertion_results.text: Status-aware handling: New issues (TC-9001, TC-9002, TC-9004) are presented for full triage, while the In Progress issue (TC-9003) triggers a warning about active work
assertion_results.evidence: status-handling.md shows: TC-9001 (New) 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)', TC-9002 (New) 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)', TC-9004 (New) 'Decision: Proceed with full triage (default path)'. TC-9003 (In Progress) 'Decision: Warn engineer before proceeding' with warning text: 'This issue is already in In Progress. It may be actively worked on.'

assertion_results.text: Ready for QA filtering: TC-9020 appears in Ready for QA (all linked Tasks Done/Closed), TC-9023 is excluded (TC-9025 still In Progress), TC-9026 is excluded (no Depend links)
assertion_results.evidence: discovery-listing.md: TC-9020 listed under 'Ready for QA (all remediation tasks completed)' with 'TC-9021 (Task, Done), TC-9022 (Task, Closed)'. TC-9023 listed under 'Excluded from Ready for QA' with reason 'Remediation in progress: TC-9025 still In Progress'. TC-9026 listed under 'Excluded from Ready for QA' with reason 'No linked Tasks with Depend link type -- no remediation to verify'. status-handling.md confirms TC-9023 excluded because 'TC-9025 (Task) -- In Progress (still active)' and TC-9026 excluded because 'no linked Tasks with the Depend link type'.
